about: Data sources named on tradingeconomics.com, one per indicator page of its sitemap ("source: …"), with the kind of body, whether its data is free, and how a program can read it. Built by Deepwater from a crawl of the public pages; the names and links are Trading Economics's. Corrected by Deepwater on 2026-11-05 after calling the sources: wrong links and programmatic access fixed, name variants merged (see docs/sources/catalogue-corrections.md).
